name: Camazotz
subtitle: Shadow of Xibalba
description: Strike enemies with feral strikes decreasing and stealing their turn meter bringing them to Despair.
lore: The “bat of death” is an agent of Omeyocan’s underworld gods, carrying their words and performing their tasks in the lands of the living. As such, he frequently appears not only throughout Omeyocan but in other realms as well—especially lately, as he has entered into some manner of scheme with the dreaded Count Dracula of Vyraj.
divinity_generator: Gain [30] Divinity when decreasing an enemy turn meter.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Turn Meter Multiplier +20%, Strong Hit Chance Multiplier +15%, Ignore RES +20%
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%
Awaken the ability: Screech of Doom

skills.name: Nightmare Theft
skills.description:
When this hero inflicts a Critical Hit, steal 5% of the target’s Turn Meter. If the attack is Strong Critical, steal a further 5% Turn Meter.

Also Decrease the target’s INIT and SPD by 5 (stacking up to 50) each time this hero steal’s turn meter.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also Decrease the target’s INIT and SPD by 5 (stacking up to 50) each time this hero steal’s turn meter.

skills.name: Dreaded Claws
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 3 times. Each hit has a 75% chance to reduce the target’s Turn Meter by 5%.

skills.name: Nocturnal Hunger
skills.description:
Attack all enemies with a 80% chance to place [mechanic:drain-ii] on each target for 2 turns.

If a target is already under [mechanic:drain-ii], also decrease their Turn Meter by 10%.
skills.awakening_bonus: If a target is already under [Drain II], also decrease their Turn Meter by 10%.

skills.name: Screech of Doom
skills.description:
Attack all enemies 2 times. Each hit has a 80% chance to reduce the target’s Turn Meter by 10%. If the target is above 50% Turn Meter, place [mechanic:spd-down-ii] on them for 2 turns, otherwise place [mechanic:despair] on them for 1 turn.

Each hit is a guaranteed Strong Critical.
skills.awakening_bonus: Each hit is a guaranteed Strong Critical.

imprint_passive: When this hero inflicts a Critical Hit, steal 2.5% Turn Meter. If the attack is Strong Critical, steal a further 2.5% Turn Meter.
